minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  June 26, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on June 26, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf – District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre –
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle – District 3, Commissioner Vicki
  Perryman-Banks – District 4, Commissioner Jacques Lesure –
  Commissioner at Large

  Absent: None

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Banks and seconded by Commissioner Battle
that the minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on February 17, 2024, be
approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Banks, and Lesure
Noes: None

SPECIAL PRESENTATION. Greg Spero with Tiny Room Studios shared a video of what he
has been doing for the past couple of years. The studio is moving but lacks funding. A
nonprofit organization has offered to buy everything but will need to raise $300,000 –
600,000 within one (1) month to keep the studio in Inglewood. They are open to ideas
from the Commission on how to fundraise.

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Creative House Utility Box Project and Gallery Exhibition –IGAP 2023 is scheduled
  to be completed by the end of the month.

  1
   Arts Commission

  b. In memoriam - Richard Wyatt, Jr., an Inglewood Public Art Collection Artist (1954-
  2024)

PUBLIC REMARKS. None

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Creative House Utility Box Project Reception will be held on Saturday, June 29,
  2024 – Formal invitation to follow.
  b. Next Arts Commission Meeting: July 17, 2024 at 6:30 pm

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:29 p.m.
